ad_copy.name: Ad1 Fatigue Refresh - Tiny-Space Phone
ad_copy.concept: For the 31-year-old scrolling on the sofa after dinner thinking the workout window has closed, show the tiny-space, no-gear 10-minute workout already on her phone right beside her.
ad_copy.headline: Ten minutes. Just your floor.
ad_copy.primary_text: Your 10-minute workout lives on your phone. No gear, just a little floor space. Start with a 7-day free trial.

claims.text: Workouts need no equipment and fit a small floor space at home

scenes.angle: the missed moment on the sofa
scenes.prompt: Candid photograph of a woman in comfortable soft athleisure sitting on a lived-in sofa at early evening, holding the phone from the reference photo in her hand tilted toward camera with screen on but no text visible, small rug and houseplant and mug of tea on side table beside sofa, 35mm lens, eye level, medium shot from 2.5m, soft window light from side, muted sage cream and warm wood palette, relaxed quiet mood, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, subject looking at phone not at lens, only one device in frame
scenes.words: Your evening still has ten minutes

scenes.prompt: Candid photograph of same woman midway through a bodyweight squat on a small rug in a warm lived-in apartment corner, the phone from the reference photo propped on the floor against a folded towel facing camera with screen on but no text, rolled yoga mat and water bottle nearby, 35mm lens, eye level, close medium shot from 1.5m angled slightly down, soft golden window light, sage cream warm wood palette, calm focused mood, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, only one device in frame
scenes.words: No gear. Just your living-room floor

scenes.prompt: Candid photograph of same woman sitting on the small rug after workout, relaxed and breathing easy, the phone from the reference photo resting beside her on the rug facing camera with screen on but no text, window with morning light and houseplant and running shoes by door in background, 35mm lens, eye level, medium wide shot from 2m, bright soft natural light, muted sage cream warm wood palette, encouraging satisfied mood, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, only one device in frame

video.proof: Show up nightly and build a streak

video.proof: Show up nightly and build a streak

checked: reference product photo: phone shape, colour and UI match the phone in all three scenes and all four video shots - one device per frame
scene 1 (sofa), scene 2 (tiny-space squat) and scene 3 (payoff) - no AI faults: hands, faces and objects intact, no melted forms or gibberish text in the photo
overlay words and Try It button in all scenes and video - readable on poster/panel/offer bands and not covering face or phone
creative kit avoid list in all scenes - no gym machines, scales, food, body-focused framing, before/after, extra text/logos or second device, and no looking into the lens
brand voice, seasonality and look - encouraging plain copy, early-November indoor habit, candid warm lived-in palette with soft window light
storyboard - three scenes and video hook/benefit/proof/end card tell one tiny-space no-gear story and follow the test brief key message
